sampling: Prefix before integer hour t; all same-hour actions atomic. Event changes at h+1, rolling expiries at h+8761. Plot steps, not interpolation. Plot dollars derive from integer microUSD.

operating_endpoint.assuranceScope: Local provider assumption only; full late-debit reserve retained for conservative investment
operating_endpoint.fundingScope: Bounded principal-plus-fee exposure; arbitrary additional debits are not guaranteed

post_drain_endpoint.assuranceScope: Local provider assumption only; full late-debit reserve retained for conservative investment
post_drain_endpoint.fundingScope: Bounded principal-plus-fee exposure; arbitrary additional debits are not guaranteed

attainment.observation: fixed daily boundaries; not annualized exit rate
